acceptance: A roster entry can set available: false or paused_until: <date or datetime>, read from a local untracked roadmap/orchestration.local.yaml overlay (so availability changes need no push) as well as the shared roster; orchestrate plan skips unavailable entries for every role, and worker delegate and review delegate refuse them with the reason
Past review records by an unavailable entry still count at their commit; tests cover available: false, a paused_until in the past and future, and the overlay
nodes.title: A roster entry can be marked unavailable without deleting it

acceptance: worker reconcile on a worker whose leaf has no registry claim (already merged) uses the node's touch zones from the roadmap instead of refusing, and worker reconcile --dismiss '<reason>' clears needs_reconcile with the reason recorded as an event; worker list and sync stop showing a dismissed or reconciled worker as needing reconcile

reconcile reports committed changes and untracked files separately; untracked-only paths outside the zones are a warning, not a failure; tests cover a merged leaf, dismiss, and an untracked file outside the zones
nodes.title: worker reconcile works on merged leaves and separates untracked files

acceptance: validate and doctor report an error-level finding when roadmap/orchestration.yaml requires reviewers (reviewers_required > 0) but git-workflow.yaml leaves require_implementation_review_before_finish off, naming both settings and the one-line fix; mark-implementation-reviewed's 'nothing to do' message says the gate is not enforced at finish
Tests cover the mismatch, both on, and both off
nodes.title: The two review-gate settings cannot silently disagree

acceptance: session start prints an export SPECY_ROAD_AGENT_ID=<id> line, and session end with no id, when no SPECY_ROAD_AGENT_ID is set and the derived id has no record, ends the single live session owned by this user in this checkout (and lists them if there are several) instead of reporting 'no record'
Tests cover the derived id differing between start and end, one live session, and several
nodes.title: session end finds the session the same agent started
